title: Kenyan President Ruto Urges African Businesses to Prioritize Intra-Africa Trade at Kenya-South Africa Forum
detail: Kenyan President William Ruto addressed the Kenya-South Africa Business Forum, calling on African businesses to prioritize intra-Africa trade as a driver of continental economic growth and integration. The forum highlighted growing bilateral trade ties between Kenya and South Africa.

media.caption: Kenyan President Ruto speaks at Kenya-South Africa Business Forum on intra-Africa trade
